title: Voltes V [English]
description: A demonic race from a planet fourteen thousand light years away called Boazan headed by Prince Heinel arrived on Earth to start an invasion to fulfill their emperor's ambition of universal conquest. Standing on their way is a group of heroic warriors piloting a a giant ultra-magnetic robot called Voltes V. It was a long and bitter struggle that took the heroes from Earth to Boazan.

title: Murder in Polná
description: An exciting drama from a detective history. In 1899 a dead girl - seamstress Anezka Hruzová - was found between the village of Veznicka and the town of Polná. She was 19 and she had a cutting wound on the throat. There was no sexual violence involved and since the local doctors thought that there was not enough blood on the crime scene, everyone jumped to the conclusion that Jews must have killed her and added her blood to their pass-over matzot. There was a potential murderer at hand too - a cheeky, not very bright young Jewish rover, Leopold Hilsner...

title: « L’ART DE LA GUERRE » l’incroyable Film RMC Sport avant BSD v PIMBLETT | UFC 329
description: Benoît Saint Denis est revenu plus fort que jamais pour signer des victoires exceptionnelles face à Ruffy, Dariush et Hooker et se hisser en quelques mois seulement dans le Top 5 de la catégorie des -70kg de l’UFC, poussant son corps au-delà de ses limites. Face à lui, la superstar anglaise Paddy Pimblett, qui reste sur une défaite héroïque face à Justin Gaethje, l’homme qui vient de choquer la planète en brutalisant Ilia Topuria, que tout le monde pensait invincible, lui arrachant au passage la ceinture de champion. Découvrez comment Benoît Saint Denis est devenu une machine de guerre implacable aux côtés de Nicolas Ott, en trouvant le juste équilibre entre violence brute, discipline et stratégie. Pimblett est lui dans l’obligation de se relever : une deuxième défaite de rang le renverrait en salle d’attente de la catégorie et sous le feu nourri des critiques liées à son image de produit marketing et de chouchou du patron. Seul le vainqueur pourra prétendre à affronter Justin Gaethje pour la ceinture. Une bataille à ne pas perdre. #UFC329 #InternationalFightWeek #GodOfWar #PaddyTheBaddy #Gaethje #Topuria #Tsarukyan #Hooker #Ruffy #Dariush #Holloway #McGregor #UFCFreedom250 00:00 L’Art de la Guerre 09 :12 BSD v Ruffy : la masterclass qui a tout changé 11 :50 BSD v Dariush : un KO des enfers en 16 secondes ! 15 :58 Hooker : BSD repousse ses limites 24 :45 Gaethje v Pimblett : Paddy perd la guerre mais gagne le respect 32 :52 Exclu RMC : au cœur de la prépa de BSD de Bayonne à Paris Ne manquez rien des combats de l’UFC en vous abonnant à RMC Sport 1 ► Toute l’actu UFC sur RMC Sport ► Suivez l’UFC avec RMC Sport sur tous nos réseaux ✓ Twitter ► Tiktok ► Facebook ► Instagram ► Tous les podcasts Fighter Club ► La playlist YouTube de l’UFC RMC Sport ► Les débriefs RMC MMA ►

title: W slowach
description: A boy struggles with tourette's syndrome

title: W Series
description: W Series is an all-female single-seater motor racing championship. It was created in response to the lack of female drivers within the motorsport industry and thus limit the chances of progressing to the highest levels of motorsport, particularly Formula 1. The series' first season was in 2019; it featured twenty drivers contesting six races.

title: F.T.W.
description: Frank T. Wells has just been released from prison after serving a term for manslaughter. Frank's a reasonably honest man and a good rodeo rider. When he meets up with Scarlett, a bank robber on the run, his whole life changes.

title: Shamshoun & Dalila
description: In a blend of comedy, suspense, and action, Shamshon is forced to steal a legendary diamond to rescue his kidnapped sister, while Dalilah is mysteriously tasked with stealing it for herself. Their missions intersect in a chase filled with tricks, pranks, and clever confrontations, transforming their seemingly disparate paths into an unexpected love story. Ultimately, they are forced to join forces with an international alliance to determine who is the best and to seize the diamond at any cost.

title: W. Somerset Maugham
description: An anthology series based on the varied stories by W. Somerset Maugham divided into three categories: "Rule Britannia" about colonial life, "Women of the World" which focus on female characters, and "Victims of Fate".

title: Mardi w Dahham
description: It follows two brothers-in-law, Mardi and Dahham, and the many problems that take place between Mardiya and her husband Dahham, while Mardi attempts to reconcile them.

title: Horror Stories
description: "Horror Stories" (Moo-seo-woon I-ya-gi) was a 2012 anthology horror movie that tells the tale of a teenager (Ji_Won Kim) who is abducted and forced to tell the scariest tales she knows, leading to this anthology of four stories.

title: S.W.A.T. Angels
description: S.W.A.T. Angels

title: Dzien, w którym znalazlem w smieciach dziewczyne
description: In the near future, the indifferent activist announces that he will commit suicide at midnight on New Year's Eve in protest against the reigning slavery in Poland. His plan is questioned when he finds an abandoned slave girl in the garbage and decides to help her regain her freedom.

title: Dr. W
description: Now you are in the domains of magic and fantasy! You are surrounded by the wonders of life and you can ask as many questions as you want! You're on the Dr. W Show! Are you afraid? Are you tired? Alone? Bored??? Have you lost your faith??? Dr. W is here and has something for everyone; No matter if you are small as a microbe or as big as the universe, fast as lightning or slow as evolution, you will get something amazing! Really surprising! So try not to get too excited, try not to laugh and shout very loudly, because what you are about to see is something that you have not seen before. Welcome ... this is the Dr. W Show! Dr. Woody Bonepecker, aka Dr. W, is a delirious doctor who is always looking for the truth of the natural facts of everyday life. He is the presenter of a TV program, and in each episode he will explain to the audience different phenomena in his particular, ironic and hilarious style. Dr. W is really stubborn, he is not afraid of anything and will do anything necessary to get to the bottom of things. In his show, Dr. W uses all kinds of resources to present and explain the topics. Not only does he perform crazy experiments as a good scientist, he also appeals to the most absurd humor as if he were a clown, or to the most fantastic magic as if he were a magician. Dr. W also has the help of special guests in many episodes, as well as an enormous variety of characters that appear to help him in the development of each theme. Likewise, the live audience has a fundamental role, as it reacts to the explanations of Dr. W at all times.

title: W Msheet
description: A lady named Meida comes back from Canada to Lebanon with her daughter Talia after 16 years of leaving the country.

title: Haya W Banatha
description: In an attempt to cover up a scandal, Haya's family forces her to wed an elderly man. As the years pass, her husband's death forces Haya to shoulder the responsibility of caring for her daughters as she tries to put the past to rest.

title: Bóg w Krakowie
description: Set today against the backdrop of a charming, mysterious and mystical city in which we follow the fate of its inhabitants: a young politician who receives a corrupt offer; girls looking for love and more.

title: 100 Days My Prince [Hindi]
description: Upon losing his memory, a crown prince encounters a commoner's life and experiences unforgettable love as the husband to Joseon's oldest bachelorette.

title: The Great W
description: In a post-apocalyptic setting, comic book fanatic Winston sets out to save a captured Deadmen operative named Emily. His spontaneous decision out of boredom gets him involved in the middle of a faction rivalry.

title: Aard W Talab
description: "The series follows intersecting lives under pressure, led by Heba, a schoolteacher who struggles to support her family, care for her brother with disabilities, and save her sick mother."

title: S.W.A.T.: Firefight
description: Detroit PD borrows an LA SWAT leader as instructor for 2 weeks training of their SWAT team. After a real SWAT action, a madman with special skills, obsessed with revenge, is released on bail.

title: 8 w poziomie
description: Poland in the near future. A man wakes up with amnesia in hotel room number 224. He's got a pile of money and a gun. He throws a rainfall of money from the terrace onto the crowded promenade. One 100-euro note floats to consecutive owners, changing their lives. All this takes place in a small Town seized with panic and fear of a terrorist bomb attack.

title: W klatce
description: Fire changes the life of a dull lonely bank cashier into a hero. He gets the woman he has always dreamt of. But, considering his modesty and peculiarity, will they really be happy together?

title: Hi Venus
description: A pediatrician and the new hospital director start off on the wrong foot due to a large misunderstanding; when they are forced to work closely, the truth is revealed.

title: Remiza. Zawsze w akcji!
description: "The Fire Station" is a warm and cheerful story, full of emotions and dramas, about a group of firefighters from the small village of Brzeziny. It is also a story about rural traditions, the strength of a small community, heroism, joy and bond building. It is not only about tense firefighting actions, but also about making mistakes, about love and the pursuit of happiness. Each episode of the series tells a separate story related to the numerous tasks of the fire brigade: extinguishing fires, removing the effects of natural disasters and the leakage of toxic substances, or assisting the police in searching for missing persons. Sometimes these situations are extremely dramatic, but they can also be humorous and funny. They are all connected by a team of firefighters, whose commander is Robert Orzechowski, a young widower, with his little daughter Karolina. His quiet life, based on work, care for his loved ones and a relationship with the firewoman Magda Wieczorek, is disturbed by the sudden appearance of high school love, Ewa. Ewa, Magda's sister, returns to her native village after twelve years. An old feeling comes to life, but is it possible to go back to what was before without hurting others?

title: Krafftówna w Krainie Czarów
description: A film, creative portrait of an outstanding theater and film actress, which takes the viewer to a world that does not exist anymore, because, as Barbara Krafftówna says in the film, "The huge world in which I lived is already on the other side of the mirror ..." Barbara Krafftówna becomes an ageless character in the film, or like a little Alice from a fairy tale, she crosses the border of realism. For years, it was the key to her acting. The film received a universal message: "Sky is the limit". Imagination has always been an escape from hopelessness for Krafftówna, because her biography, full of professional successes, was not without tragedy. Her life entered the difficult Polish history - Volhynia, the war, Stalinist times, communism, the fight for freedom. Imagination, as she put it herself, was "an escape from the void." The main narrative of the film consists of the protagonist's internal monologues, the archival ones collected over the years by the narrator and screenwriter of the film, Remigiusz Grzela, and those recorded today. These monologues refer to the most outstanding film role of Krafftówna in the film by Wojciech Jerzy Has, "How to Be Loved".

title: W the Movie
description: A surreal, apocalyptic nightmare fantasy on the George W. Bush years and the effect they have on protagonist, BlueMahler, his family, and his life.

title: 20th Century Girl [Hindi]
description: In 1999, a teen with a heart of gold begins keeping close tabs on a popular classmate as a favor to her smitten best friend.

title: Zabawa w chowanego
description: The documentary follows the story of two brothers who were sexually abused by the same priest of Polish Catholic Church.

title: Herbert. Barbarzynca w ogrodzie
description: Polish author Zbigniew Herbert is one of the most remarkable poets of the 20th century. His works have been translated into 40 languages, acclaimed and awarded around the world, mainly because of its timeless and universal dimension. In Poland, his significance is even greater, as Herbert was a moral guide in his native country. His poetry was of great importance during the fight against communism. Many Poles learned his poems by heart and remember them up to this day. However, behind the crystalline beauty of his poetry, there is a man struggling with everyday life. His story told by his wife, Katarzyna, and people who were close to him unveils a picture of a unique, yet complex artist. A model of intelligence, humor and charm, on the one hand, Herbert has been struggling with anger, physical pain and mental illness, on the other.

title: High & Low: The Story of S.W.O.R.D.
description: The legend begins at a certain town that used to be under the rule of a legendary organization called "Mugen". And fighting against the rule of this town's overlords were two legendary brothers - the brutal and unbeatable Amamiya Brothers.

title: Kamen Rider W Returns: Kamen Rider Accel
description: While settling into married life with Akiko, Ryu is brought into a case involving a woman named Katsuragi Aoi, a member of a pickpocketing ring with most of her teammates murdered from unknown masked vigilantes that Ryu fought as Accel.

title: Dimension W [English]
description: In the year 2072, the world's energy problems seem solved by a network of cross-dimensional electric-field inductors called "coils" that extract energy from a seemingly infinite source. That source is the W dimension, a fourth plane that exists beyond the X, Y, and Z dimensions. In this world, unofficial "illegal" coils harness powers that the police can't hope to counter. Dealing with these coils is the job of coil-hating repo man Kyoma, whose run-in with the unique coil android Mira leads the two to form a reluctant partnership.

title: 1 on 1's w/Deuces

title: Desire Under the Palms

description: Olga's carefree life and family dynamics slowly starts shifting after her grandmother, a very wealthy lawyer, makes an unexpected confession on her deathbed.

title: Y
description: A Balkan war veteran - who is now a homeless alcoholic - dreams that he is a tree growing inside the ruins of his house, which was destroyed in a bombing raid.

title: Serrat y Sabina: el símbolo y el cuate
Apaga... y vámonos
description: A somewhat confused and strange young inventor, named Gustavo, is arrested by the police accused of being a terrorist. Through his statements we will know the truth of the facts. During his childhood he discovers that his father wants to escape to a place called Vesta aboard a spaceship made by himself. However, during the journey he loses his life. Now thirty years old, Gustavo, after a series of events, will try to repeat his father's journey.

title: Lluvia y ceniza
description: Jaime is an unsuccessful painter who lives in his house, accompanied by Blanca, who suffers psychological abuse from him.

title: Calor... y celos
description: Carlos prepares a trip a Cuba with his lover. His plans are spoiled when his wife makes up her mind to go to Havana with him.

title: Palos y risas
description: In a town of violence and crime, a policeman works sternly. But with his cheerful, outgoing personality, he becomes the clown TRAMPOLIN.

title: Y También Gaelle
description: In 2010 an earthquake shooked Haiti, reducing the poorest country in America to rubble. A team of Spanish firefighters, accompanied by the rescue dog Turco became the protagonists of one of the most media rescue: two years old Redjeson, was found alife 48 hours after the earthquake, becoming a symbol of hope. One year after the tragedy, when the world seems to have forgotten about the little island, three Spanish firefighters decide to return to search for Redjeson and try to get their wounds to heal.

description: Two men bring a message to a manager in an office with two beautiful secretaries. The manager thinks they are the specialists he is waiting for. title: Topo y Wera
description: Topo y Wera is the result of Jean-Charles Hue's engagement with the poorest residents of the Mexican border-city of Tijuana that has long thrived on its proximity to California, but is also marked by crime-ridden deprivation. This is tough, unvarnished stuff; a glimpse into lives on the hardscrabble margins of society that many may find too much to stomach.

title: Montoyas y Tarantos
description: History about hate and passion between two gypsy families.

title: Cocolos y Rockeros
description: This documentary examines the musical tastes of Puerto Rico's youth. The terms "cocolos" refers to those who prefer "salsa" music, and "rockeros" to those who prefer "rock" music. Through interviews and an array of musical settings the film explores the young people's feelings in a humorist yet serious manner, bringing to the forefront issues of biases and national identity inherent in this innocent yet very powerful form of social entertainment. Includes musical performances by Gilberto Santa Rosa, El Gran Combo, REO Speedwagon and others.

title: Love & Mathematics
description: A former pop star and a fan of his boy band struggle to fit in with society.

title: Martes y trece
description: Lola and Maria are two Spanish young ladies engaged to Franz and Pepe, all so eager to spend their honeymoon that the moment seems never to come, as all sorts of problems pave their way.

title: Chasing Luck(Y)
description: A man who plays lottery for years suddenly wins 4 million euros, despite his previous lack of success. However, a winning ticket somehow finds its way to the hands of local pub's owners. After finding out that the police and two local crooks are after them, they escape to Greece, but their hosts mistakenly make announcement of the lottery winners over all mediums. From that point, everybody sets out on the way to Greece hoping to find the missing ticket.

title: Oscuro y Lucientes
description: Goya's body remained forgotten in a pantheon in Bordeaux. Decades later, everyone present at the exhumation was greatly surprised: Goya's skull was missing.

title: Orgullo y Prejuicio
description: A pesar de la presión social para casarse, Lizzie Bennet, la segunda de las hermanas Bennet, está decidida a quedarse soltera. Pero cuando su padre cae gravemente enfermo, Lizzie se ve inesperadamente arrastrada al mundo clasista del cortejo con tal de salvar a su familia de la ruina. Tras un encuentro decisivo con el reservado y misterioso millonario, el señor Darcy, Lizzie se enfrenta a una elección: negar sus sentimientos por el bien de su familia o dejarse llevar por un amor tan apasionado como imprudente.

title: Rosas y Espadas
description: Sandra luchó en la batalla en lugar de su padre y fue nombrada Gran General. El emperador quiso concederle un matrimonio, pero ella reveló su identidad femenina. Renunció a su título y regresó a su hogar. Para compensarla, el emperador nombró a su prometido, David. Sin embargo, se casó con Lisa, quien fingía ser la hermana del general. Cuando el reino vuelve a caer en el caos, el canciller Alberto la trajo de vuelta. Al final, los dos alcanzaron sus ideales y se quedaron juntos.

title: Punto y raya
description: "Punto y raya" is the story of a young Colombian recruit who, while patrolling his country's border, is befriended by a Venezuelan adversary, and the tragic consequences of their relationship.

title: Sal y Pimienta
description: A Spanish talk show where the latest scoops of mostly Hispanic pop culture is reported on.

title: Fulano y Mengano
description: The stay in the prison of Eudosio and Carlos, accused unjustly, prevents them from getting a job when they go free. As much as they intend to explain that they were locked up for no reason, nobody will listen to them. So they decide to steal to stay alive. His house is a whole building in ruins, without any closed window and with the walls that are barely standing. Esperanza will try to turn that space into a home, where she works with enthusiasm. But life is very hard and coexistence is also difficult.

title: Helena y Fernanda
description: An important industrialist suffers a neurosis. In a violent argument he strikes his wife and apparently kills her. Then the body disappears. Criminal melodrama inspired by a similar situation set out by Henri Georges Clouzot in 'Les diaboliques'.

title: 70 Y Pico
description: Grandpa, why did they try to kill you? The documentary addresses the animic changes that the filmmaker experiences while he tries to understand the participation that his grandfather played, as a civil associate, during the last military dictatorship in Argentina. The role that he played as the Dean of the Architecture Faculty at the University of Buenos Aires, as a link with the concentration camp ESMA, is one of the multiple topics that grandpa "Pico" narrates in camera.

title: Generation Y
description: A group of ragtag twenty year olds find themselves wanting more out of life in the city of Angels.

title: The Y
description: The Y is a SciFi psychological thriller about a woman with a split soul searching to reconnect before she becomes TheY.

title: YRYR S1-S3
description: A Comedy Series that revolves around the daily lives of the Amusement Club, consisting of Akari Akaza, her childhood friends, Kyoko Toshino and Yui Funami, and her classmate Chinatsu Yoshikawa

title: Y Syrcas
description: A unique film for all the family. Set in 1848, it tells the story of a young girl who is bewitched by the excitement of the travelling circus as it visits her small town in west Wales.

title: Contigo pan y cebolla
description: The purchase of a fridge (a huge investment then) is a pretext to show the joys and hardships of a traditional Cuban family in the 50s. Extremely funny.

title: Hermanos y detectives
description: Franco Montero, a frustrated detective, receives a second chance when he is forced to adopt his 10 year old brother (who happens to be a child prodigy). With his help, Franco will solve the most complicated mysteries.

title: Marcelo y María
description: In the sixteenth century, two young indigenous fall in love, but being slaves, they will have to submit to their masters or fight for their love at all cost.

title: Perros y Diablos
description: A bank robbery goes wrong, and Cobra is the only one who served time for it. 10 years later, those involved reunite to celebrate his release from prison, but things have changed, and the new gathering of friends turns out to be different.

title: Cásate y Verás
description: The adventures and misadventures of married couples at different stages of life with humor and laughter.

title: Lucho y Ramos
description: An absentminded burglar is caught in the act by the owner of the house he's stealing.

title: ¿Y ahora que?
description: 13-episode Documento-fiction series whose aim is to help boys and girls who are going through puberty to understand the physical, hormonal, social and emotional changes that take place at this stage of life.

title: Y+
description: A series of sketches about the miseries of life in the 21st century and its effects on the human condition.

title: Genio y figura
description: When the pregnant Esther gets some bad news from her doctor, he advises her to visit a clinic in Mexico City, so she enlists husband Antonio to drive her there at once, along with her brother Luis. As soon as the men drop her off at the hospital, they hit a local nightclub and live it up, and as they are leaving the club in the company of a sexy dancer, they get thoroughly robbed: the criminals even steal the poor victims' clothes! Taken in to the police station and documented along the way, their photograph turns up in the paper the next day, which Esther of course sees. The men will have a lot to explain when they arrive at the clinic to pick up Esther.

title: Y si ella volviera
description: Sonia, a school teacher, is excited about her new post in the Cuban beach town of Caibarien since her childhood friend Guillermo lives there. However she finds Guillermo a tormented soul and evil lurks in town.

title: Oro y Polvo
description: The real-life story of a drug cartel leader set to Macbeth.

title: Superagentes y titanes
description: Un importante empresario llega al pais para producir un film con los famosos Titanes.

title: Mariana y Scarlett
description: Amor, desamor, envidia y traición son los ingredientes de la nueva novela Mariana y Scarlett, la historia de dos hermanas que, sin saberlo, se enamoran del mismo hombre. Mariana y Scarlett son dos mujeres de clase media, bonitas, luchadoras y con un gran anhelo de superación. Pero ahí terminan los parecidos. Mientras Mariana es seria, dulce, serena y quiere hacer todo por el camino correcto; Scarlett es divertida, pícara, agresiva y quiere hacer todo por el camino rápido. El deseo de la primera es montar su propio taller de confecciones y hacer sus propios diseños, el de la segunda es ser una modelo internacionalmente reconocida. En su camino hacia el cumplimiento de su sueño ambas se cruzarán con Roberto White, un millonario dueño de una textilera, cuyo matrimonio está roto y que, mientras consigue el divorcio, saldrá con las dos hermanas pero con identidades diferentes. Con Scarlett será Roberto, millonario y empresario, mientras que con Mariana será Boby, empleado en una agencia de seguridad. Cuando Roberto se da cuenta de que se ha enamorado de Mariana, romperá con Scarlett, pero la dicha no lo durará mucho, ya que Mariana no tardará en descubrir el engaño, lo que le llevará a romper con él para siempre. Scarlett por su parte descubre que Roberto la abandonó por Mariana, lo que hace que su relación de hermanas se afecte de manera irreversible. Scarlett y Mariana se convierten entonces en rivales por la lucha del amor de un hombre, Roberto.

title: Celestino y el vampiro
description: In Old San Juan a 40+ year old divorcée is not aware he befriends a vampire who bites women, not in their necks but in their derrières, leaving them with flattened behinds. A vampire hunter from Europe warns Celestino about his neighbor and tries to recruit his help in salvaging a much cherished national heritage. But there is a difficulty: this vampire will not die by a stake through his heart and to avoid destruction he wears tin underwear.

title: Las dos y media y... veneno
description: The old Don Senén has squandered in sprees the inheritance of his niece Begoña rather than manage it. There is still a million pesetas, which will only be delivered after the death of Don Senén. To get it, the old man, in complicity with Begoña and two other nephews (Ramón and Marcos) will fake his death. But Ramón and Marcos really planned to poison their uncle putting cyanide in his milk to keep them with money - When poor Quintín, Justo and Paloma (funeral parlor's workers) arise at Don Senén's home they will find an overview full of misunderstandings.

title: Sol y Luna

title: Susana y el sexo
description: Susana Estrada was the first artist in Spain to perform a full nude on stage, a striptease, assuming its innumerable consequences. Her constant involvement with the subject of sex cost her the suspension of her passport and the right to vote. Looking at the past through Susana's story is also looking at a Spain that repressed women, a struggle that still lasts today.

title: Kava z Kardamonom
description: Lviv, at the dawn of the nineteenth century. Young Anna is living a simple life, helping her uncle in the bakery, while her brother is in the seminary. Yet, Anna dreams of something much grander: true, mutual love. Her family has a different idea for her. She is supposed to marry the wealthy tradesman Marykan - and while he is in love with her, she cannot muster the same feelings for him. Then everything changes, when Count Adam Rodzinsky arrives to visit his sick uncle Witold. First, Anna is afraid of the older Adam. But then, she develops feelings for him, especially when they start to cross paths more and more frequently. Turns out, Adam was once married to a distant relative of Anna's, but the relationship ended in tragedy. Anna reminds him of his former beloved. Yet as their love blossoms, it remains forbidden.

title: Z: Hatenaki kibou
description: The film is based on a manga, which is full of zombies, the film depicts three eras randomly and intermittently. In one era a mysterious virus is spreading which upon contact zombifies both humans and animals. Being bitten by a zombie makes you one too. In the second era the virus is everywhere around the world and governments are powerless to fight it. Everybody is fighting. In the third era the virus has stopped spreading for unclear reasons, yet the zombies remain everywhere and still need to be fought.

title: Z Joke

title: Malá z rybárny
description: Everyone's familiar with Hans Christian Andersen's The Little Mermaid, the story of a love capable of forgiving even the greatest betrayal. In Jan Balej's film - a work filled with wonderful animation, expressive puppet designs and an imaginative, shifting score from French composer Chapelier Fou - the fairy-tale romance is replaced with a bleak portrayal of life in a city harbor, yet its enduring message remains.

title: Hrad z pisku
description: A mother and her daughter live alone far from human habitation. They are happy. Their harmonious relationship is interrupted by the unexpected arrival of a foreigner with his interpreter. In spite of the lack of verbal communication, the mother and the stranger fall in love, the daughter accepts him as well. The budding relationship is disturbed by the interpreter who realizes her power.

title: Z-ERO
description: Johnny Barnes, an otherwise average man trying to survive in a world being taken over by zombies, is infected by an Alfa female zombie. To his surprise, he discovers that he not only retains his cognitive abilities but has inherited special abilities too. He finds himself now on a mission to help rid the world of the cold-bodies and discover his full potential.

title: Pozegnanie z diablem
description: A young journalist tries to solve the mystery behind a murder in a small town.

title: Poslední z Aporveru
description: A fantasy story about a boy and girl who save the wold of Aporver by their love.

title: Jobe'z World
description: Jobe, a mysterious middle-aged rollerblader, gets blamed for the drug overdose of a super famous A-list actor. Afraid and confused, he spends one bizarre evening skating across the streets of Manhattan, all the while dodging paparazzi, police, and assorted late night weirdos.

title: Z pekla stestí
description: Once upon a time there was a farmer. His daughter Dora was mean, lazy and quarrelsome, but his stepdaughter Magareta was sweet, pretty and hardworking. So it happened that the servant Hannes fell in love with Magareta. When Hannes asks the farmer for Magareta's hand, the jealous Dora is disappointed. In revenge, she hands Hannes over to the king's soldier recruiters and drives Magareta out of the house. Hannes saves himself to two devilish journeymen, who equip him with some magical things for his further way. The and new strong friends help Hannes to save his Magareta and at the same time free the people from a tyrannical king.

title: Dziewczeta z Nowolipek
description: Bronka, Franka, Amelka and Kwiryna are four girls living in the same poor district of Warsaw and going to the same school. They all fight for a better future but what the future brings is usually disappointment, sometimes even tragedy.

title: Plan Z
description: One man has a plan for a zombie outbreak, when one occurs it will take all his will to stick to it and all of his courage to change it.

title: Pojdi z mano
description: In search of the best photo for the school competition, four teenagers head to remote hills. The competition for awards turns into a struggle for survival. Manc, who leads the group to remote but scenic countryside, where he spent his childhood with his grandpa, had been accused of stealing a phone and consequently might be expelled from school. Schoolmates Mina, Oto and Spurc join him on this trip. Mina, who is spoiled, stubborn city girl, breaks first in this foreign environment, but luckily by her side always stands Oto, rational boy who is in love with her. In this untouched nature which is such an unknown world to them also Spurc, who was golden-spoon-fed all his life, turns into a cowardish spoiled-child, and at the end Manc is again the one who safely guides them back home. A story about growing up, love, friendship and heroism. The warm but suspenseful and occasionally spine-chilling film focuses on what happens in the today's world when technology stops working and the 'primal' human instincts come to light.

title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero [Hindi]
description: Aryabhatt ka zero is a heartwarming slice of life drama that celebrates the power of self-belief through its core philosophy—"Believe in Yourself." The film follows the journey of Brahamgupta Shrivastava, affectionately known as Baggu, a 25-year-old directionless young man from a middle-class family. Dismissed as a failure by society and burdened by self-doubt, Baggu struggles to find purpose in a world that constantly underestimates him. As life throws one challenge after another at him and his family, Baggu embarks on an unexpected journey of resilience, hope, and self-discovery. With unwavering support from his loved ones and the courage to believe in himself, he gradually transforms from an overlooked nobody into an inspiring hero. Packed with humor, emotion, and relatable moments, AKZ is an uplifting story of ordinary people fighting extraordinary battles. It reminds us that every "zero" has the potential to become a hero when they choose to believe in themselves.

title: Zero Position
description:
An experiential journey through the war in Eastern Ukraine along the ideological borderland between East and West, Zero Position explores the intricate layers of hidden powers that shape the conflict before the 2022 Russian invasion. Introducing civilians and combatants on both sides, who are numbed and shattered by the ongoing conflict, the film explores stark realities and sheds light on a country with dueling identities, wherein loyalty to one ideology or the other can result in either survival or demise.

After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, Ukraine declared independence. In 2014 pro-Russian separatists declared independence from Ukraine in two small regions in Eastern Ukraine, Luhansk and Donetsk. War then broke out between Ukrainian and Russian backed separatist forces, and a 450 km static frontline was established in Eastern Ukraine. Cities, coal mines, power plants, and steel mills are on the frontline in a region that was once the industrial heartland of the Soviet Union. Thousands have been killed, wounded, and displaced. Crucial infrastructure such as bridges have been destroyed to cut off access to separatist territory, segregated civilians from resources they had formerly relied upon. Meanwhile countless land mines and unexploded bombs litter the landscape, making daily travel a routinely precarious affair.

Director and journalist Louie Palu serves as a surrogate for the viewer, navigating ruined landscapes to have honest and unmediated conversations with civilians and combatants alike, illuminating the psychic impacts of the ongoing conflict on the populace. The film takes viewers on tours through strategic sites such as power stations and the Azovstal steel mill in Mariupol that was the focus of Russian attacks early in the invasion. We are even allowed to sit with families and hear their thoughts on the conflict, the ideologies behind it, and the way it is shaping the lives of children.

Zero Position reveals the reality of desperation, institutional decay, personal trauma, and slave-like working conditions often hidden from the West by a patchwork of legacy Cold War controls related to state security and an inability for most journalists to report there and reach Western audiences.

title: El 1%
description: El 1%
An unmarried actress in Munich becomes pregnant but decides against marrying the child's father, and eventually moves in with a more agreeable man she meets on a winter sports holiday.

Off-beat dramedy following Pat (she hates Patricia), exuberant and melancholic author during a winter stay in her childhood cabin where buried memories resurface. Pat needs to look into the mirror and forgive herself in order to heal and save her relationship with her musician boyfriend Jan and maintain the fragile bond with her tween daughter Flavie. 1+1+1 features a restless but strong female lead and a blended family trying to live together, where each member is learning to love him.herself and to love each other.

title: Make Mate 1
description: "Make Mate One" is a program that contains the meaning of "Time to become one with MAKE friends (MATE) to create the stage you dreamed of," and it is a program that depicts the process of 36 multinational participants running toward their dream of becoming an idol. It is not a survival program involving trainees belonging to an entertainment agency but a survival program performed by ordinary boys who do not have an agency. The final debut group will debut as Makestar's new boy group.

title: 4 Idiots
description: King, Queen, Jack, and Ace-four misfits surviving through petty crimes in Chennai-found their world turned upside down when COVID-19 lockdowns shut down public transport, their main source of income. Desperate for a way out, King discovered an audio recording about a bungalow filled with black money, supposedly guarded by a lone watchman. Seeing it as their golden opportunity, the gang set out to execute the perfect heist. However, upon entering the bungalow, the door slammed shut behind them, and a chilling voice welcomed them. The so-called security guard was none other than Pulibaba, a notorious gangster. With a gun in hand, he forced them to surrender their belongings and made a sinister phone call: "Doctor, the delivery is ready... Eight kidneys." Their dream of a quick fortune has turned into a nightmare of survival. Now, they have only one choice: outsmart Pulibaba or become the next victims of his dark business. A twisted game of greed, betrayal, and survival is about to unfold.
